title: Extending a Helping Hand: $15,000 to Opportunities of Development Thru Art
author: Aaron
body:
For a city which relies so heavily on tourism in order to thrive, the streets of Siem Reap are a far cry from their usual hustle and bustle.

COVID-19 continues to unfold, radically altering the face of travel as we know it, and many cities like Siem Reap are feeling the impact. Shirley, a dedicated volunteer for Opportunities of Development Thru Art (ODA) says, “The streets are just totally empty. And the sad part is the majority of people in and around Siem Reap earn their money through tourism…I just don’t know how they’re surviving.”

In July 2020, OneTomorrow made an emergency grant of $15,000 to ODA. This non-profit organisation provides free English education to children living in Siem Reap’s remote villages, with the aim to improve future employment opportunities. For the past 11 years, the APT Travel Group (ATG) has supported Siem Reap’s ODA network which includes eight free English schools and social work in local villages.

According to Shirley, this much-needed donation will go towards the “schools that [ATG] kindly fund each year…the teachers would have no income if we weren’t able to pay them.”

With the help of this donation, ODA will be able to continue their work supporting the dozens of children in their care and serving to enhance their future prospects. And during times as challenging as these, this support is more important now than ever.
